mandatory_requirements.description: Stable tradable-security identity distinct from ticker, issuer and listing, with ticker reuse and share classes resolvable.
Historical ticker validity intervals or equivalent source events with causal revisions.
Historical exchange or MIC and listing validity independent of current state.
Machine-readable historical security type without ticker-shape inference.
Listing, inactive, delisting, first-trade and final-trade state through time.
Provably raw open, high, low, close and volume with session, revision and lineage semantics.
All active securities in the documented V1 universe.
Inactive, delisted, failed, acquired and bankrupt histories without survivor backfill.
Required event census, stable event identity, effective and knowledge times, terms and revision history.
Terminal status, dates, reasons, genuine final-trade references, consideration and successors with provenance.
Qualified exchange session, timezone, publication and correction timing for daily bars.
As-received or versioned historical records sufficient to prevent later corrections contaminating earlier cutoffs.
Effective, published, received and usable times sufficient to enforce usable_time at or before signal_cutoff.
Reproducible source releases, schemas, files, hashes and provider identifiers.
Confirmed automated local quantitative research, durable storage, derived-data and retention rights.

mandatory_evaluations.assessment: PERMNO is a permanent security identifier, separate from company-level PERMCO, and CIZ carries it through historical reference, bar, action and delisting tables.
CIZ historical security-information intervals carry ticker and validity dates under PERMNO.
Historical exchange and listing attributes and exchange calendars are defined in interval and metadata tables.
Share and security type codes are delivered historically under stable security identity, permitting explicit common-stock inclusion.
The product explicitly covers active and inactive securities and provides historical security and delisting records.
CIZ defines regular-session daily open, high, low, close and raw share volume; exact 2016-plus common-stock population and missing-field completeness must be confirmed before purchase.
The published product scope includes active US securities.
The product scope explicitly includes inactive securities and dedicated delisting records under PERMNO.
CIZ distributions provide broad action terms and dates, but public evidence does not prove a complete V1 event census with historical publication, received and revision chronology.
Delisting records include dates, reasons, status, prices, payments and successor IDs; historical knowledge time and complete event-version history remain unresolved.
Regular-session bar field and exchange-calendar semantics are documented, but exact package publication and correction timing is not public.
Release notes prove versioned corrections exist, including historical rewrites, but public materials do not establish subscriber access to every historical as-received release from 2016 onward.
